content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for DMHS Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.dnh.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 20-08-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DMHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the DMHS Recruitment 2026 is 20-08-2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the DMHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies announced for the SMO Panchkarma, Accountant, MPW, and Staff Nurse posts in the DMHS Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for DMHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode for the DMHS Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to send their application form to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Accountant post?
faq.answer: For the Accountant post, candidates must possess a B.com degree with at least 2 years of experience in the government sector and a certificate in Tally Accounting Software. Proficiency in MS Office and a typing speed of 35 WPM in English are also essential.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the SMO Panchkarma post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the SMO Panchkarma post will receive a monthly salary of ₹ 60,000/-.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for DMHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the DMHS Recruitment 2026. The application is free of cost.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the DMHS Recruitment 2026 will be based on an interview. Candidates shortlisted based on their applications will be called for the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I download the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of DMHS, which is www.dnh.gov.in. The direct link is provided in the Important Links section.

faq.question: Q9. What is the minimum experience required for the MPW post?
faq.answer: For the MPW post, candidates must have completed an Auxiliary Nurse Midwife / Multipurpose worker course and possess at least one year of experience in the field.

faq.question: Q10. Which state is this recruitment for?
faq.answer: This recruitment is for the Directorate of Medical & Health Services in Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu, specifically for the city of Silvassa.
